title: Can It Run: DeepSeek-R1-14B Locally (Ollama)
symptom: Can my laptop with RTX 3050 6GB VRAM, 16GB System RAM, and Intel i7-11800H run DeepSeek-R1-14B or Llama-3-8B locally via Ollama? What quantization and layer offload limits should I expect?

expected_output.symptom_summary: Feasibility analysis for deploying 8B and 14B parameter LLMs locally via Ollama on an RTX 3050 (6GB VRAM) and 16GB system RAM.

evidence.text: DeepSeek-R1-14B or Llama-3-8B locally via Ollama

possible_causes.cause: Hardware VRAM boundary (6GB) is insufficient to fit a 14B model fully into GPU memory (which requires ~9GB in 4-bit Q4_K_M).
possible_causes.verification: Check Ollama model size with 'ollama show deepseek-r1:14b'; verify weight footprint exceeds 6GB VRAM.

possible_causes.cause: PCIe bus bandwidth bottleneck during partial GPU offloading when layers spill over into system DDR4/DDR5 RAM.
possible_causes.verification: Compare tokens/sec between full GPU offload (Llama-3-8B) vs partial CPU RAM offload (14B model).

troubleshooting_steps.action: Run 7B/8B models (such as Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct or Gemma-2-9B) using Q4_K_M quantization for 100% GPU VRAM execution.
troubleshooting_steps.rationale: An 8B Q4 model consumes ~4.8GB VRAM, leaving ~1.2GB for Windows DWM and context KV cache.

troubleshooting_steps.action: For DeepSeek-R1-14B, configure Ollama layer offloading with ~24 layers on GPU and remaining on CPU RAM.
troubleshooting_steps.rationale: Allows the model to execute without CUDA Out of Memory errors, with acceptable ~8-12 tokens/sec speed.

troubleshooting_steps.action: Ensure no other GPU-intensive 3D apps or browser hardware-accelerated tabs are running during inference.
troubleshooting_steps.rationale: Frees the maximum contiguous VRAM pool on the 6GB device.
